fact: The acting INS Director General said at the 8 October 2025 SYNPIS congress that the 5th population and housing census (after 1977, 1988, 2001 and 2012) is fully financed with partners' support, budget estimated above 35 billion FCFA, and in active preparation.
A related-posts list on the INS page carries a headline, dated 7 April 2025, on the continued pilot enumeration of the 5th general population and housing census.
A related-posts list on the INS page carries a headline, dated 30 March 2023, for the final report of the national fertility survey.

The INS Niger data catalogue lists the Enquete Harmonisee sur les conditions de vie des Menages 2021/2022 (survey, Institut National de la Statistique), with entries created on 12 February 2024 and 16 December 2024.
